description.value:
Rolled off the production line just last year, the D6 Hawk has raised the eyebrows of solos worldwide. It’s a complicated rebuild of Nokota’s massively successful Osprey, utilizing the blocky, heavy frame to create a stable, high capacity, and reliable DMR/LMG hybrid. It even retains the burst fire of the Osprey, though its impact force is less potent than its predecessor. Still, the Hawk indicates a shift in Nokota’s direction: less low-cost designs and more top-shelf mercenary gear whose rising success (and profits) might end up drawing the ire of some less than enthused competitors.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 60 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Battle Barrel, Constant Recoil System, Flared Magwell (w/ Drum Magazine), Infrared Nightvision Scope, Power Rebuild, Improved Silencer • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst and has all expended ammunition also function as Armor-Piercing Ammunition. It cannot fire if there are less than 3 rounds in the magazine. This weapon imposes a -2 penalty to Perception Checks made to hear it firing [Improved Silencer]. Requires BODY 10+ or paired Cyberarms to not reduce DEX and MOVE by 1 while wielded.

Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Battle Barrel, Constant Recoil System, Flared Magwell (w/ Drum Magazine), Infrared Nightvision Scope, Power Rebuild, Improved Silencer (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
